scope_guards: Climate hazards remain separate and are not collapsed into one parcel score.
A 2-degree or 4-degree scenario is not a prediction for one site or date.
National risk categories are not candidate-specific likelihood or impact values.
Flood allowances require the correct catchment, epoch and development lifetime.
Flood-map or FRA triggers do not replace a satisfactory site-specific assessment.
National FCERM strategy is not a local defence commitment or guaranteed standard of protection.
Planning and permit adaptation requirements remain distinct.
Exact lifetime, hazard data, site assessment, adaptation measures, planning and infrastructure evidence is required.
